name: kyzegs/guzzle-rate-limit-middleware
description: A configurable Guzzle middleware for rate limiting HTTP requests based on response headers

suggest.ext-redis: Redis via phpredis, for RedisStore (lock-free atomic reservations) and RedisLockFactory
suggest.predis/predis: Redis via Predis, for RedisStore (lock-free atomic reservations) and RedisLockFactory
suggest.psr/clock: Pass a PSR-20 clock (e.g. symfony/clock) as the middleware clock via Psr20Clock
suggest.symfony/lock: Locks shared across hosts (Redis, PDO, ...) via SymfonyLockFactory
